Fixed greeting formed from god (“good”) + kveld (“evening”), literally “good evening”.
The first element, god (“good”), is from Old Norse góðr (“good”), from Proto-Germanic *gōdaz (“good”), ultimately from Proto-Indo-European *gʰedʰ- (“to join, unite, suit”).
